I saved this to the project's shared memory: Priya owns the ledger integration, and any change to `src/billing/invoices.py` needs her review. It's linked to that file, so it will come up whenever someone edits it or opens a PR that touches it.

It goes with an existing note about the same file: `finalize()` isn't idempotent (calling it twice posts to the ledger twice), so code should use `finalize_once()` instead.
